content:
Twelve years ago we changed our professions and decided to open the first kosher, organic, vegan, living food restaurant in America, located in Del Mar California. For ten years we helped people to transform their lives and health. This was a healing process for us and we want to thank Hippocrates. Their teaching of personal responsibility is the most important lesson of any teaching we can all learn.

Vol 23 Issue 2 page 5
